title: Detection Concatenation
text: Cluster detections, 3 inputs, 2 outputs, {Cluster threshold epsilon} sets Cluster neighborhood size; {Define outputs for Simulink block} sets the type of cluster data output, {Source of cluster threshold epsilon} sets the epsilon source, {Minimum number of points in a cluster} sets the minimum number of points required, {Maximum number of points for ’Auto’ epsilon} sets the maximum number of points required, {Length of cluster threshold epsilon history}, {Enable disambiguation of dimensions} sets the turn on disambiguation, {Indices of ambiguous dimensions} and {Simulate using} sets the block simulation method Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: X
ports.summary: Input data N -by- P real-valued matrix

ports.name: Update
ports.summary: Enable automatic update of epsilon false (default) | true

ports.name: AmbLims
ports.summary: Ambiguity limits 1-by-2 real-valued vector (default) | 2-by-2 real-valued matrix

ports.name: Idx
ports.summary: Cluster indices N -by-1 integer-valued column vector

ports.name: Clusters
ports.summary: Alternative cluster IDs 1-by- N integer-valued row vector

params.name: Define outputs for Simulink block
params.values: Type of cluster data output Index and ID (default) | Cluster ID | Index

params.name: Cluster threshold epsilon
params.values: Cluster neighborhood size 10.0 (default) | positive scalar | positive real-valued 1-by- P row vector

params.name: Minimum number of points in a cluster
params.values: Minimum number of points required for cluster 3 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Maximum number of points for ’Auto’ epsilon
params.values: Maximum number of points required for cluster 10 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Length of cluster threshold epsilon history
params.values: Length of cluster threshold epsilon history 10 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Indices of ambiguous dimensions
params.values: Indices of ambiguous dimensions 1 (default) | positive integer | 1-by-2 vector of positive integers

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Block simulation method Interpreted Execution (default) | Code Generation
